title: White's Relationship with Black Revealed
description: White does not hate Black despite recognizing him as a danger. He seeks to balance Black's freedom with the safety of the world.

title: Magenta's Future Discussed
description: The possibility of Magenta settling down romantically is addressed, emphasizing his nature as a Fragment.

title: Fragment Interaction with Black Explained
description: All Fragments can interact with Black, though most approach him cautiously. None hate him despite his destructive potential.

title: Fragment Immortality Explained
description: Fragments cannot normally be permanently killed by one another because death has been removed from their existence.

title: Favorite Foods Revealed
description: The favorite foods of numerous Fragments are publicly revealed.

title: Fusion Concept Introduced
description: The existence of Fragment fusion is officially explained. Multiple Fragments can merge into entirely new beings.

title: Grey Revealed
description: White and Black are confirmed capable of fusing into Grey, an incomplete physical manifestation of the Whole One.

title: Fragment Population Confirmed
description: The total number of Fragments is confirmed to be exactly twelve.

title: Ainul Explained
description: All Fragments fusing together always results in Ainul, the complete Whole One.

title: The Beast First Mentioned
description: A mysterious form known as The Beast is revealed to exist beyond ordinary Fragment states.

title: Magenta's Dancing Talent Revealed
description: Magenta is revealed to be one of the most skilled dancers among the Fragments.

title: Lavender's Gaming Ability Revealed
description: Lavender is shown to outperform Yellow in competitive gaming.

title: Official Top Five Power Ranking
description: Black, White, Taffy, Umbra and Cider are revealed as the five strongest Fragments.

title: Fragment Solidarity Explained
description: Hurting one Fragment is effectively hurting all of them due to their shared familial bond.

title: Red vs Blue Matchup Clarified
description: Despite elemental advantage, Blue is still unable to overcome Red's overwhelming raw power.

title: Rindo Preferences Revealed
description: Blue and Red are identified as the Fragments most likely to enjoy the Rindos.

title: Fragment Sparring Confirmed
description: Fragments sometimes engage in serious combat to settle disputes due to their inability to permanently kill one another.

title: Permanent Fragment Death Explained
description: Certain reality-defying entities and almighty beings are capable of permanently destroying Fragments.

title: Ainul's Unique Existence Clarified
description: A distinction is established between immortality and Ainul's state of being literally unable to die.

title: Fusion Memory Retention Revealed
description: Fragments retain memories and emotional bonds formed during Fusion.

title: Fusion Stability Explained
description: Fusions are not temporary and can exist indefinitely unless they willingly separate or experience severe internal conflict.

title: The Beast Revisited
description: The Beast is confirmed to be Ainul's equivalent of an Overclock state.

title: Overclock Power Clarified
description: An Overclocked Fragment can surpass multiple Dormant and even certain Awakened Fusions.

title: Fragment Animal Forms Mentioned
description: The concept of animal counterparts for Fragments is discussed but remains undeveloped.

title: Recursive Fusion Confirmed
description: Fusions are capable of fusing with other Fragments and Fusions. The final result remains identical regardless of fusion order.

title: The Fragmentation
description: Ainul becomes divided into the Fragments.

title: Formation of Grey
description: Black and White fuse to create Grey.

title: Rise of the Seven Thrones
description: The great throne fusions emerge.
